title: Vanilla Expansion
description: A lightweight modpack, designed solely for the gaming experience.
body:
# Brief Description
 
Welcome to our Modpack, and we can't wait to show you what it's all about!

This modpack is designed to run on low-performance devices, and includes a number of optimized mods, as well as some survival mods and some Biomes expansion mods for an unparalleled gaming experience!

This is an exciting project, and we're all working together to make it the best it can be. While we expect there may be some bumps along the way, we're committed to making this a success. If you encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to me.
I would absolutely love your support! 🙏🏻💰 You can easily donate using the link on the right. ☺️ Thank you so much!
> Designed on Fabric!


By the way, we recommend Java 21 to boot the game.

Check out the awesome mods I've added to the modpack below!

<details>
<summary>What Mods We've Added in the Modpack</summary>
Sodium Family, Dynamic FPS, REI, MASA Mods Family, Carpet, Xaero's Maps, Medieval Buildings, ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village, Oh The Biomes We've Gone, Terralith, Repurposed Structures...
  
And more mods to explore!


</details>


You can absolutely make your own modifications within the modpack! Go for it — it's totally permitted!

We provided a Chinese translation below.
